socialPost.text:
NextClaw v0.40.0 is out.

Large tool-heavy sessions reopen up to ~6× faster. Panel Apps can live in the main sidebar, QQ delivery is more resilient, and runtime failures are traceable.

https://docs.nextclaw.io/en/notes/2026-08-20-nextclaw-v0-40-0
